name: MetaHealth VR
summary:
MetaHealth is an innovative virtual reality clinical simulation platform designed for training and assessing medical skills. The system combines an immersive VR application with a web-based educational management platform, allowing students and healthcare professionals to interact with virtual patients in a simulated environment that faithfully reproduces clinical practice. The web platform allows for the creation of medical cases for use in VR.
